Building data frames
```{r}
my_data_frame<-tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)
print(my_data_frame)
```
```{r}
my_data_frame<-tibble(
  fruit=c("apple","pear","banana"),
  length=c(22,30,55),
  weight=c(150,165,170)
)
gt(my_data_frame)
```
```{r}
radiation_data_frame<-tibble(
  cell_ID=c("CX1","CX2"),
  treated=c(TRUE,FALSE),
  num_cells_before=c(5415, 8123),
  num_cells_after=c(1432, 7543)
)
gt(radiation_data_frame)
  
```
